scope: Local source implementation and automated receiving; not an installed package, platform matrix, release candidate or human visual acceptance.

design.axis: Molecular Cartesian coordinates, independent of camera orientation; unit-free finite nonzero vector.
design.angle: Explicit signed degree/radian; positive quarter-turn about +z maps +x to +y.
centers: Per-structure unweighted geometric center of unique selected atoms (GUI default)
design.review: No center computation or molecular trajectory copy. Apply-time centers share the serialized managed edit/read operation; native shape (n_structures,1,3) and requested order are retained.
design.effects: Managed current-system edit and scene update, or full independent result changing only requested atoms/structures.
design.periodicity: Box stays fixed. No wrapping/reconstruction; Euclidean rigidity is not a MIC-invariance promise.
design.lifecycle: Native analysis coverage invalidation; expiring single-use reviews; completed science is never replayed to recover projection.

addon.selection: tests/molsysviewer_molsysmt (before adding the independently received no-copy-review case)

checks: Render the source through the real notebook presentation surface
Review a molecular-axis rotation and cancel without changing Mol* vertices
Apply a signed quarter turn about each structure centroid and inspect actual vertices
Create an independent negative-radian rotation about a unit-bearing fixed point
The rotated result keeps its identity across window and notebook destinations
Rotation axis angle and fixed point survive canvas and Studio popups
Python verifies every selected and unselected atom and structure
gui.scientific_checks: Independent signed quarter-turn oracle for actual Mol* vertices; all selected/unselected native atoms/structures, unchanged chemistry/box, original versus invalidated analysis coverage and separate result ownership.

tests.overlap: The 5091-case addon and 551-case directed selections overlap; their counts must not be added.

fast.scope: Fast source controls only; not the full release gate.
